title: Characters and coherent linearizations on a trivially acted scheme
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], $T$ a group scheme over $F$ [def-sc-group-scheme], and $Z$ an $F$-scheme [def-pc-scheme] with trivial action. Use the multiplicative group [def-sc-gm-ga], whose multiplication is commutative, and write $X=\operatorname{Hom}(T,\mathbf G_m)$ additively and $R=\mathbf Z[X]$, with basis $e^\chi$ and $e^\chi e^\psi=e^{\chi+\psi}$. Split tori are those of [def-sfb-tori-multiplicative-type]. For an $\mathcal O_Z$-module $M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], put $M_z=z^*M$ using [def-pc-module-pullback]. A trivial-base linearization consists, for every $W/F$ and $z:W\to Z$, of a group homomorphism $T(W)\to\operatorname{Aut}_{\mathcal O_W}(M_z)$, natural under every $f:V\to W$ via the canonical pullback-composition comparison. This is the forward action, equivalently the inverse of the descent isomorphism with its identity and cocycle laws. A coherent linearized object has underlying coherence [pqf-def-coherent]. A morphism is equivariant when its pullbacks commute with all these actions. A subobject $P\subseteq M$ has weight $\chi$ if, on every test scheme, its pulled-back inclusion intertwines the action on $M_z$ with multiplication by $\chi(t)$ on $P_z$. A module is pure of weight $\chi$ when its entire action is multiplication by $\chi(t)$. A weight decomposition is a family of coherent weight subobjects whose inclusion cocone is a coproduct and whose nonzero support is finite.
